# Route the scope to this feed
# Once per project, or per machine with --global.
swift package-registry set --scope polaris-key https://pkg.plrs.im/swift/polaris-key

# Refuse an unsigned or untrusted release (.swiftpm/configuration/registries.json)
{
  "security": {
    "default": {
      "signing": {
        "onUnsigned": "error",
        "onUntrustedCertificate": "error"
      }
    }
  }
}

# Depend on the package (Package.swift)
.package(id: "polaris-key.PolarisKey", from: "0.9.0")
